Each change gives its reason and every case it alters. Each case names its test and, in was, the frozen exit code and the FNV-1a hashes of the frozen stdout and stderr; the replay checks both before replacing the answer and requires stderr to stay the same, and the exit code too unless the case sets exit_code_changes to true.
